lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Hello, Blossom.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I'm Flora,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: a member of the Botanic Garden Squad.✿
Nice to meet you.
Looking forward to working with you.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: It's a joy to meet you.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: You have great sense, Blossom.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: It's a pleasure to meet you.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I collect flowers and seeds from up on the surface

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: and cultivate them in my garden.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: If you need anything

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: or are ever curious about flowers,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: feel free to stop by the garden anytime.✿
Got it.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Is there a flower you particularly like,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Blossom?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I'm planning on introducing a new flower to my garden,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: and would love to grow one that you are fond of, Blossom.
I don't know much about flowers.
I like anemones, violas, and a few others.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: When you visit the garden,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I'll tell you more about them.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: There are so many kinds of flowers in the world.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I'm sure there will be at least one that you love.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I didn't expect you to be so interested in flowers.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I'll do my best

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: to cultivate the flowers you love most

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: before you come to visit.✿
I'll stop by for sure.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Chatting with you

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: really makes it feel like time has flown by.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: It's already time to give the flowers their nutrients.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: May I message you again in the future?
Of course.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Thank you.✿

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: I hope you have a wonderful day.✿
